en: Vintage black‑and‑white view of a cobblestoned town square with several multi‑story buildings. A large corner building prominently bears the sign "Apotheke." (pharmacy). In the center is a fountain or well with a statue. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand around the square, and a horse‑drawn cart is visible to the right. Printed caption text at the bottom identifies the scene as Pulsnitz, Bismarckplatz and credits the publisher Brück & Sohn, Meissen.
